sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) - 1m
limits: product accuracy is not parcel-specific uncertainty
newer target survey cannot be inferred from composite metadata alone

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
facts: 25 cm/50 cm/1 m/2 m depending on survey
metadata record period extends to 18 April 2024
limits: dataset-level period does not prove target coverage
exact target metadata intersection required

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents FeatureServer layer 0
facts: fields include sd_flown, ed_flown, pt_spacing, transform, geoid, latest and polygon_id
limits: service availability is not an exact target result
cannot prove post-2022 target survey

sources.name: National LIDAR Programme
facts: repeat blocks captured based on need
data published quarterly on an ongoing basis
limits: repeat-survey existence is location-specific
exact target intersection required before freshness upgrade

sources.name: LIDAR Ground Truth Surveys
facts: timestamped LIDAR must pass <+/-15 cm RMSE
limits: +/-3 cm applies to independent control points, not parcel DTM result
ground-truth dataset period does not prove a current control point at target

sources.name: Persistent LIDAR WCS guidance
facts: year suffix removed for persistent service URLs
persistent path intended to provide most up-to-date service without annual URL changes
limits: WCS availability does not equal successful target raster sample

sources.name: INSPIRE July 2026 download
limits: INSPIRE geometry is not guaranteed exact legal boundary
not elevation evidence

sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data catalogue
limits: catalogue currentness is provenance only
not exact boundary or terrain accuracy

sources.name: INSPIRE GML technical guidance
facts: reprojection to WGS84/Web Mercator can shift some features up to 15 m
limits: reprojected web geometry cannot be exact native match basis

sources.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 4 - determined boundaries
facts: general boundary is not exact line
determined boundary shows exact line for register purposes
coordinate-based determined plans require National Grid coordinates with +/-300 mm absolute and +/-10 mm relative accuracy
limits: ordinary INSPIRE/title-plan polygon must not be promoted to determined-boundary precision without register evidence

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 current download
limits: secondary cross-check only at parcel scale

sources.name: OS Downloads API
facts: automated discovery and download of OS OpenData
current product metadata and download links
OpenData access does not require API key
limits: API availability is not proof that Terrain50 target archive has been downloaded and sampled

sources.name: National Geoid Model OSGM15
facts: nominal 8 mm rms geoid-model accuracy on mainland UK
limits: 8 mm is transformation-model accuracy, not LiDAR elevation accuracy

sources.name: National Grid Transformation OSTN15
facts: legacy simple Helmert only roughly metre-scale
limits: horizontal transformation accuracy is not terrain measurement accuracy

sources.name: Ordnance Survey coordinate systems
facts: National Grid is horizontal mapping coordinate system
OS Net/ETRS89 plus transformations provide modern access to both
limits: EPSG:27700 horizontal coordinates alone do not define vertical height datum
